metadata.title: Jordan Whittington - Practices Thursday
metadata.description: Whittington (quadriceps) was a limited participant in practice Thursday, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: Whittington sustained the quad injury in Week 1 against the 49ers and hadn't practiced since that game before Thursday. Now, he's trending in the right direction as Sunday night's showdown with Denver approaches. Whittington caught one pass for eight yards on the 25 offensive snaps he played in the Rams' season opener.

metadata.title: Jordan Whittington - Doesn't practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Whittington (quadriceps) did not participate in Wednesday's practice, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: Whittington has failed to practice since sustaining a quadriceps injury during the Rams' Week 1 loss to the 49ers. The wide receiver has missed four consecutive practices and appears no closer to suiting up for the team's Week 3 showdown with the Broncos on Sunday.

metadata.title: Jordan Whittington (quad) likely a non-participant Wednesday
metadata.description: Jordan Whittington (quad) is likely to be a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Whittington is not expected to take part in Los Angeles' walkthrough on Wednesday, though the team's official injury report has yet to release. He could miss another game, which would open up more opportunities for Terrance Ferguson again, especially if Puka Nacua (hip) is also sidelined for another game.

metadata.title: Jordan Whittington - Inactive for Week 2
metadata.description: Whittington (quadriceps) is inactive for Monday's game against the Giants.
metadata.analysis: Whittington drew the doubtful tag for MNF after missing practice all week due to a quad injury he sustained in the Rams' Week 1 loss to the 49ers. He'll join fellow wide receiver Puka Nacua (hip) in street clothes, and the duo will aim to be available for Week 3 against the Broncos on Sept. 27. The Rams will have four active wide receivers in Davante Adams, Konata Mumpfield, Xavier Smith and Tutu Atwell for Monday's game.

metadata.title: Jordan Whittington Officially Out For Rams on Monday
metadata.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Jordan Whittington (quadriceps) is officially inactive for the Monday night game in Week 2 against the visiting New York Giants, the team announced. In addition to Whittington, the Rams will be without All-Pro receiver Puka Nacua due to a groin injury, so their receiving corps will be thinned out beyond veteran Davante Adams. The 25-year-old Whittington was doubtful to play in Week 2 after missing practice all week with a quad injury that he picked up in the season-opening loss to the division-rival San Francisco 49ers in Australia. It remains to be seen if Whittington will be able to play next Sunday night in Denver against the Broncos in Week 3. In the season opener, the former sixth-rounder in 2024 from Texas caught his only target for a pickup of eight yards. Despite L.A.'s explosive offense, Whittington is just a depth piece and is not currently rostered in any Yahoo leagues.

metadata.title: Jordan Whittington - Doubtful for Monday
metadata.description: Whittington (quadriceps) is doubtful to play in Monday's game against the Giants, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.
metadata.analysis: Whittington has not practiced since sustaining his quadriceps injury in the Rams' Week 1 loss to the 49ers. The wide receiver's likely absence for Monday's contest would be made even worse if Puka Nacua (groin) were also unable to suit up. Konata Mumpfield and Xavier Smith could see increased roles against the Giants, but if multiple wide receivers must miss time, it is likely the Rams will live in 13-personnel packages with the team's deep tight end corps.

metadata.title: Jordan Whittington Doubtful for Monday Night
metadata.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Jordan Whittington (quad) is doubtful for Monday night's game against the Giants, according to Stu Jackson. Whittington did not practice Friday and is now unlikely to play after the quad injury surfaced late in the week. He caught his only target for eight yards in the opener against San Francisco while playing 25 offensive snaps. His status matters more with Puka Nacua also questionable. Whittington is listed directly behind Nacua on the Rams' depth chart, with Xavier Smith next in line. If Whittington sits, Los Angeles may have to dig deeper into its receiver rotation, especially if Nacua is limited or unavailable.

metadata.title: Jordan Whittington (quad) added to injury report Friday
metadata.description: Jordan Whittington (quad) was added to the injury report as a non-participant on Friday.
metadata.analysis: Whittington is at risk of being sidelined in Week 2 after missing Friday's practice due to a quad injury of some kind. Puka Nacua (hip) is also at risk of being sidelined now, so fantasy managers should pay close attention to updates about the health of these two receivers prior to Monday night's game.

metadata.title: Jordan Whittington - Misses practice Friday
metadata.analysis: Whittington logged 25 offensive snaps in the 27-7 loss to the 49ers in Week 1, finishing behind Puka Nacua (43) and Davante Adams (33). However, he ended with just one catch for eight yards. While there doesn't appear to be much upside surrounding Whittington ahead of the Week 2 meeting with the Giants, that could change if Nacua, who also didn't practice Friday due to a hip issue, can't suit up for that contest.

metadata.title: Jordan Whittington is Avoidable After Forgettable Opener
metadata.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Jordan Whittington (quad) was not seen on the practice field on Friday. Whittington is in danger of missing Monday's game against the New York Giants. Even if he's healthy, Whittington is unlikely to be a factor in this offense right now. He hauled in his lone target for eight yards during the Week 1 loss to the San Francisco 49ers. The 25-year-old only played 41 percent of the offensive snaps and doesn't appear to be a focal point in the Rams passing attack. It's worth noting that Puka Nacua (hip) missed Friday's practice as well. Whittington could step into a larger role if Nacua is out, but fantasy managers can leave Whittington on the waiver wire for now.

metadata.title: Jordan Whittington - Catches one pass in Week 1
metadata.description: Whittington caught his lone target for eight yards in the Rams' 27-7 loss to the 49ers in Week 1.
metadata.analysis: Whittington played 25 of 61 offensive snaps but saw his playing time elevated some late in the fourth quarter after the Rams pulled their starters. He also saw 13 snaps on special teams, returning four kicks for 94 yards. Whittington may need some injuries ahead of him to be a useful fantasy asset.
